# Boardwright

> Lay out a board game as zones, card templates and coloured decks, declare the rules, run a readiness check over the model, then export reference renders plus a JSON spec and written brief an AI agent can build the game from

- Live: https://boardwright.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: static-site, editor, export, game, tabletop, json, localstorage
